tokens.name: brand-color-primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Primary button, active nav item, checked controls, focus border). White text on it.

tokens.name: brand-color-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Primary tint: focus-ring shadow, primary tag fill, badge ground.

tokens.name: brand-color-primary-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Primary tint on hover.

tokens.name: brand-color-primary-border
tokens.usage: Border of primary-tinted elements.

tokens.name: brand-color-primary-border-hover
tokens.usage: Border of primary-tinted elements on hover.

tokens.name: brand-color-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: brand-color-primary-active
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: brand-color-primary-text
tokens.usage: Text in primary color on light grounds. Dark theme value #5f5f5f is low-contrast on dark grounds: decorative use only there.

tokens.name: brand-color-success
tokens.usage: Success state: completed transcription, saved session. Pair with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: brand-color-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success alert / tag ground.

tokens.name: brand-color-success-border
tokens.usage: Success alert / tag border.

tokens.name: brand-color-success-hover
tokens.usage: Success control on hover.

tokens.name: brand-color-success-active
tokens.usage: Success control pressed.

tokens.name: brand-color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state: model still loading, low disk space.

tokens.name: brand-color-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning alert / tag ground.

tokens.name: brand-color-warning-border
tokens.usage: Warning alert / tag border.

tokens.name: brand-color-warning-hover
tokens.usage: Warning control on hover.

tokens.name: brand-color-warning-active
tokens.usage: Warning control pressed.

tokens.name: brand-color-error
tokens.usage: Error state: recognition failed, file unreadable. Light value is 3.3:1 on white: use for icons, borders and 24px+ text, not body text.

tokens.name: brand-color-error-bg
tokens.usage: Error alert / tag ground.

tokens.name: brand-color-error-border
tokens.usage: Error alert / tag border.

tokens.name: brand-color-error-hover
tokens.usage: Error control on hover.

tokens.name: brand-color-error-active
tokens.usage: Error control pressed.

tokens.name: brand-color-info
tokens.usage: Info state and the one chromatic accent of the UI.

tokens.name: brand-color-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info alert / tag ground.

tokens.name: brand-color-info-border
tokens.usage: Info alert / tag border.

tokens.name: brand-color-link
tokens.usage: Link text and Link buttons. Light value is 3.6:1 on white: fine for 14px semibold links, prefer link-active for long text.

tokens.name: brand-color-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link on hover.

tokens.name: brand-color-link-active
tokens.usage: Link pressed; also the accessible link colour for body-size text on white.

tokens.name: brand-color-text
tokens.usage: Primary text: transcript body, labels, headings. On bg-container, bg-layout and bg-elevated in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, speaker metadata, timestamps. On bg-container and bg-layout.

tokens.name: brand-color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: hints, placeholders, captions. 3.3:1 on white (source value): 12px+ hint text only, never for content.

tokens.name: brand-color-text-quaternary
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative glyphs. Fails contrast on purpose: never for readable content.

tokens.name: brand-color-fill
tokens.usage: Strong neutral fill: switch track off, slider rail, scroll thumb.

tokens.name: brand-color-fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Neutral fill: hovered list rows, segment highlight.

tokens.name: brand-color-fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Light neutral fill: input group addons, code blocks.

tokens.name: brand-color-fill-quaternary
tokens.usage: Lightest neutral fill: zebra rows in tables.

tokens.name: brand-color-bg-layout
tokens.usage: App background behind panels.

tokens.name: brand-color-bg-container
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, inputs: the main working surface.

tokens.name: brand-color-bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, modals.

tokens.name: brand-color-border
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, Default buttons, dividers between panels.

tokens.name: brand-color-border-secondary
tokens.usage: Hairline borders inside panels: table rows, card outlines.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand accent from brand.json: the app's one neutral-dark accent. Dark theme follows brand-color-primary.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Brand canvas from brand.json: window background. Dark theme follows brand-color-bg-container (no dark value in the source).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Brand surface from brand.json: side panels (300px left, 360px right). Dark theme follows brand-color-bg-layout (no dark value in the source).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink from brand.json: maximum-contrast text on canvas and surface. Dark theme follows brand-color-text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Brand muted from brand.json: borders, inactive icons, 12px+ meta text only (3.3:1 on canvas, source value).
